clayWaterEnzyme.title: Why Clay Water Enzyme?
clayWaterEnzyme.description: We believe true cleanliness starts from the most basic element: earth. Clay Water Enzyme (CWE) is a kaolin clay–based innovation that is not only cleansing, but also safe, natural, and acts as a natural antiseptic.

points.title: Natural origin
points.description: Kaolin clay has been used for centuries as a cleansing and detoxifying agent. We combine it with enzyme technology for maximum effectiveness.

points.title: Health & safety
points.description: Free from harsh chemicals, gentle on skin, suitable for the whole family.

points.title: Shariah compliance
points.description: The formula can be used for sertu (najis mughallazah), making it simple, fast, and reliable.

points.title: Versatile use
points.description: From personal care and daily sanitation to halal industry needs, CWE fits modern lifestyles.

clayWaterEnzyme.conclusion: With CWE, we aim to deliver hygiene solutions that are cleaner, safer, and more blessed.

about.title: About Us

products.featuredDescription: Discover our most popular products designed to enhance your health and wellness journey.

vlskin-bodywash-500ml.name: VLSkin Bodywash 500ml
vlskin-bodywash-500ml.shortDescription: Gentle cleansing with fine, comfortable foam (500ml)
vlskin-bodywash-500ml.longDescription: VLSkin Bodywash is formulated with premium ingredients to provide gentle yet effective cleansing for all skin types. Our advanced formula creates fine, comfortable foam that thoroughly cleanses while maintaining your skin's natural moisture balance. Perfect for daily use by the whole family, this bodywash leaves your skin feeling refreshed, clean, and soft without any harsh chemicals or artificial fragrances.
vlskin-bodywash-500ml.howToUse: Wet the body, pour onto palm or sponge, lather gently all over, then rinse thoroughly.

vlskin-clay-bar-soap-80gm.name: VLSkin Clay Bar Soap 80gm
vlskin-clay-bar-soap-80gm.shortDescription: Compact clay bar for gentle cleansing without drying
vlskin-clay-bar-soap-80gm.longDescription: VLSkin Clay Bar Soap combines the natural cleansing power of clay with gentle moisturizing properties. This compact 80gm bar is perfect for travel and daily use, providing effective cleansing without stripping your skin of its natural oils. The clay formula helps to remove impurities while leaving your skin feeling smooth and refreshed. Its solid form makes it more economical and environmentally friendly compared to liquid soaps.
vlskin-clay-bar-soap-80gm.howToUse: Lather onto palm or sponge, apply to skin, then rinse thoroughly.

vlsartu-liquid-clay-1000ml.name: VLSartu Liquid Clay 1000ml
vlsartu-liquid-clay-1000ml.shortDescription: Consistent clay mix for sertu cleansing (1000ml)
vlsartu-liquid-clay-1000ml.longDescription: VLSartu Liquid Clay provides a consistent and practical solution for sertu cleansing according to Islamic principles. This pre-mixed clay solution eliminates the guesswork in preparing the correct clay mixture for cleansing najis mughallazah. The liquid form ensures even distribution and effective cleansing on various surfaces including metal, plastic, glass, and floors. Available in both household and industrial sizes to meet different needs.
keyBenefits: Simple solution for sertu cleansing of najis mughallazah
Suitable for metal, plastic, glass & floor surfaces
vlsartu-liquid-clay-1000ml.howToUse: 1. Remove physical traces of impurity. 2. Wash once with water mixed with Premix Sertu Solution. 3. Rinse 6 more times with clean water.

vlscent-natural-sanitizer-200ml.name: VLScent Natural Sanitizer 200ml
vlscent-natural-sanitizer-200ml.shortDescription: Quick-drying natural sanitizer for hands and surfaces (200ml)
vlscent-natural-sanitizer-200ml.longDescription: VLScent Natural Sanitizer offers effective hand and surface sanitization using natural ingredients. This 200ml spray bottle provides quick-drying, non-sticky sanitization that's comfortable for daily use. The compact size makes it perfect for travel, office, or personal use. Formulated with natural ingredients, it provides reliable sanitization without harsh chemicals, making it safe for frequent use by the whole family.
keyBenefits: Small size, perfect for travel & pocket use
vlscent-natural-sanitizer-200ml.howToUse: Spray onto hands or surfaces, rub evenly & let dry.
